description: "Competent authority" is used for granting type approval (A2.P0.pt10), for testing conformity (A2.P0.pt13), for issuing certificates (A2.P0.pt16) and in Article 6; whether these are one position is not stated.
treatment: Coded as one TYPE position, competent authorities of the Member States; no distinction invented.
effect_on_claims: Claims on who recognizes, tests or issues are stated at the TYPE only; no instance or role-split claim.

description: The legal constitution of the authority or authorities competent to issue type approval rests on national measures that W does not reference (no specific source is identified).
treatment: Position recorded as TYPE with constitution not_applicable; not an EXT record because no source is referenced.
effect_on_claims: Constitution of these authorities is undetermined; relations are coded as stated.

description: Which laboratories are "approved testing laboratories" depends on the external CEPT accreditation system and on national approval acts not in W (EXT accreditation system).
treatment: Position recorded as TYPE; no laboratory instance or count is stated.
effect_on_claims: Identity and number of approved laboratories are undetermined; claims touching laboratory qualification are restricted to within the declared corpus.

description: "a Committee, which shall be the Working Party of Senior Officials on Telecommunications" may be direct establishment (N1) or designation of an existing body for the Directive's purposes; the Chairman office is implied by "shall be chaired". Recital 14 ("necessary to set up a Committee") cannot support a record and is cited only as context (REC14).
treatment: Norm type recorded AMBIGUOUS; entity constitution not asserted; duties of the Committee are coded as duties constituted by the norm.
effect_on_claims: No claim that the Committee or Chairman is constituted_by_N1.

description: Duties or competences are stated for or toward the CEPT and CEN/CENELEC, which are not addressees of the Directive (A12.P0); the Directive's binding force on them is not evidenced by W.
treatment: Coded as stated at epistemic status documented (for the CEPT-origin relation); no claim about binding force.
effect_on_claims: Relations with CEPT/CEN/CENELEC rest on the Commission side only for legal_constitution_evidenced.

description: Telecommunications administrations (including private operating agencies) are not addressees; the Directive states the Member States' duty to ensure their behaviour.
treatment: Relation coded as the Member State duty to ensure; the administrations are the counterpart.
effect_on_claims: Binding force on the administrations is not evidenced by W.

description: The composition of the Committee (who its members are) is not stated in W; "members of the Committee" and "experts or advisers" are not identified as categories with other norms.
treatment: No member instance or composition counterpart is invented; the permission is coded as an NA of members.
effect_on_claims: No claim about representation of Member States in the Committee.

description: The accreditation system can be singled out and has an establisher (CEPT), but its governing rules are outside W and its function is stated only by reference; device threshold is borderline.
treatment: Recorded as DEVICE row with classification BORDERLINE_INS-TYPE; used as INS-TYPE in relations.
effect_on_claims: No device-level claim is asserted.

description: "shall supplement as necessary" is obligation-framed but conditional on necessity ("as necessary", "where necessary").
treatment: Coded as N0 obligation with the discretion recorded in the conditions.
effect_on_claims: None beyond the record.

description: The content of the "general programme of standardization in the information technology sector" and the meaning of "due regard" are outside W.
treatment: Recorded as EXT (not constitutive); duty coded as stated.
effect_on_claims: None on relations; claims about the programming basis are restricted to within the declared corpus.

description: The frozen function vocabulary has no fitting category for assistance of Committee members by experts (A5.P1) or for financial settlement (A8.P3.sub3) (GAP-05).
treatment: FUNCTION_VOCABULARY_UNRESOLVED written in the function field; the legally grounded description is kept in action/mechanism.
effect_on_claims: Function-based property statements for these records are not made.

description: A6.P1.sub2 provides that "Reference to NETs shall be published" (publisher unstated); A6.P2 speaks of a specification "the references to which are published"; A8.P4 speaks of "the list published in the Official Journal". Their identity is not stated.
treatment: Not assumed identical; the feedback route from suspension to withdrawal and recognition conditions is not asserted as an I3 consequence.
effect_on_claims: ARCH I3 limited to the A6.P2 conditional dependency.

description: A6.P3.sub2 extends "the procedure for exceptions referred to in Article 7 (4)" to competent authorities "in respect fo [sic] the first subparagraph"; the Article 7(4) exceptions concern purchasing by telecommunications administrations, and the referred first subparagraph must be identified.
treatment: Read as A6.P3 and the A7.P4 exceptions; coded as a permission with epistemic status documented; queued.
effect_on_claims: SC-04/SC-02 coupling via this cross-reference is not relied on.

description: "the certificate ... must be accompanied by" is stated about the certificate, not as a duty of a named party; the recipient is not stated.
treatment: Bearer read as the issuing approved laboratory; norm type COMPOUND (duty and/or condition on the recognition effect); no counterparty invented.
effect_on_claims: NA recorded at documented; not a relation.

description: Exception (a) states conditions for replacement or transition equipment without stating who may invoke the waiver; exception (b) states a Member State permission; the exceptions to "ensure" are stated as exceptions to the Member State duty.
treatment: Permission coded only for case (b) where stated; case (a) recorded as a condition of the ensure-relation.
effect_on_claims: No permission is asserted for case (a).

description: The Committee is to review "the situation"; the Member State applying the waiver is not stated as the object of the review.
treatment: Coded as an NA of the Committee without counterparty.
effect_on_claims: No oversight relation Committee to Member State is asserted.

description: The holder of the certificate, the issuer and the territorial scope of a suspension of "recognition of a certificate" are not stated.
treatment: Coded as NAs without counterparty.
effect_on_claims: No relation between the suspending Member State and the issuer or holder is asserted.

description: The addressees and the legal effect of the Commission's "recommendations or opinions" are not stated.
treatment: Coded as an NA without counterparty.
effect_on_claims: Accountability sufficiency assessment is restricted accordingly.

description: "the procedures set out in paragraphs 1 and 2": paragraph 1 states an option and an informing duty; paragraph 2 refers to an external procedure.
treatment: Read as A8.P1.sub2 (informing duty) and A8.P2 (external procedure); coded as a derived NA at documented; queued.
effect_on_claims: Relations triggered by revocation are not coded beyond the informing duty of A8.P1.sub2.

description: The transposition deadline is derived as one year after adoption (adoption dated 24 July 1986 in the signature block, giving 24 July 1987); the date of notification or entry into force is not stated in W.
treatment: Deadline stated as derived in validity notes; no application date asserted.
effect_on_claims: Legal status in_force is asserted for the declared temporal reference only.

description: The approval and verification of laboratories by the Member State or a recognized body is stated in a definition in descriptive form ("has been verified", "is approved"); A7.P2 presupposes approvals without stating an operative competence (GAP-07).
treatment: Two definition-derived QR records coded with modality definition at documented; queued.
effect_on_claims: SC-03 and ARCH rely on these records only at documented status.

description: Residual function tag authorization_designation* (flagged in the frozen vocabulary) is the nearest function for approval and for authorization of an extension.
treatment: Residual tag used and flagged (GAP-05).
effect_on_claims: Function-based statements about these records are provisional.

description: Consultation, assistance, chairing, secretariat, proposal and advisory-opinion relations fit none of the ten relation types cleanly; representation_participation (and review_adjudication for advisory opinions, contractual_exchange for financial settlement) is the nearest type.
treatment: Coded to the nearest type with a flag in type_note (RGAM-DR-15); no new type created.
effect_on_claims: Type-based aggregation over these records is not made.

description: The legal constitution of a NET rests on adoption procedures of an external Memorandum of Understanding.
treatment: EXT recorded with constitutive_dependency Y; relations in W coded as stated.
effect_on_claims: Claims on how specifications come into existence and on alternative routes are undetermined.

description: A2.P0.pt16 lists "an approved laboratory or the competent authority in a Member State" as possible issuers; A7.P3 names the approved laboratory; a relation with the competent authority of another Member State as issuer is not coded (same TYPE position on both sides).
treatment: Counterpart coded as the approved laboratory (A7.P3) and queued.
effect_on_claims: Mutual recognition among competent authorities is not asserted as a separate relation.

description: The act of "another Member State presents evidence" is stated as a trigger of waiver cessation, not as an explicit permission; "his waiver" is printed as such.
treatment: Modality coded as permission (inferred from the trigger); queued with direction conventions.
effect_on_claims: QR retained at legal_constitution_evidenced for the origin Member State only as a trigger.

description: "which may submit their comments to it": "it" is resolved as the Commission from the next subparagraph, not stated in the same sentence.
treatment: Derived QR with the context rule; queued.
effect_on_claims: Direction of comments is by context.

description: "If no agreement is reached without four weeks" is printed as such; read as "within four weeks".
treatment: Condition recorded verbatim with the reading noted.
effect_on_claims: None.

description: The accountability elements are distributed over several provisions; the agent and standard of "not maintained", the effect of recommendations or opinions and the consequence of ground (b) assessment are not stated.
treatment: Coded ACCOUNTABILITY with sufficiency indeterminate and missing elements listed.
effect_on_claims: PROP accountability structure for SC-05 is undetermined.

description: "within a period of two years following the implementation of this Directive": "implementation" is not defined (adoption, notification or transposition).
treatment: Time limit recorded verbatim; start date not asserted.
effect_on_claims: Timing of the Commission proposals is undetermined.

description: "Such lists and reports shall be transmitted to the Committee ... for information": the transmitting actor is not stated.
treatment: No QR or NA coded; statement only; queued.
effect_on_claims: SC-03 does not rely on transmission to the Committee.

description: In case (a) "the Commission shall be informed ... this information shall be given to the Committee": the informing actors are not stated.
treatment: No QR or NA coded; statements only; queued.
effect_on_claims: Information duties of case (a) are not in SC-04.

description: The reimbursement is "in accordance with the procedures for payment then negotiated with the Member State": a later agreement not in W.
treatment: Recorded in the validity note and support-gap report; not an EXT (no source referenced).
effect_on_claims: Modalities of reimbursement are undetermined.

description: RGAM-DR-25 states "unresolved coverage or constitutive external reference -> INDETERMINATE" in the sentence about distinct architectures; it is read here as applying to every candidate touched by a constitutive EXT.
treatment: Candidates assessed INDETERMINATE and the reading logged (deviation log); queued.
effect_on_claims: All candidate outcomes INDETERMINATE.

description: The frozen documents do not state how legal_constitution_evidenced is applied to the duties of a directive; the executor applied: legal_constitution_evidenced where the legal subject of the duty or competence is an addressee (Member States) or a Community institution/organ to which the instrument assigns the task (Council, Commission, Committee) and no constitutive EXT touches the claim; otherwise documented.
treatment: Applied uniformly; limitation text on links; queued.
effect_on_claims: Status profile depends on this rule.

description: The mapping of the ten dimensions to families F1-F5 (ON section 6.1) is not available in the allow-listed sources.
treatment: property_family left blank; no family invented.
effect_on_claims: No family-based statement.
